finding.daily_volume: Yahoo/run80 daily historical volume is split-adjusted on the present share-count basis.
finding.intraday_1h_volume: Yahoo 1H session volume is on a point-in-time/nominal share-count scale, not multiplied by later split factors.
evidence: 3350 around its 1->10 split: frozen daily pre-split volume is 10x the unadjusted historical-volume presentation paired with unadjusted prices.
Cross-sectional V43 receipt: 22/22 selected symbol-dates with two sessions and a future split factor were closer in log-error to daily_volume/future_split_factor than to adjusted daily_volume.
Examples: 6574 future factor=100, raw1H/day adjusted-volume ratio about 0.0094 while raw1H/PIT-daily ratio about 0.944; 2334 factor=10 raw1H/PIT ratios around 0.75-1.42.
